title: DocCraft
body:
DocCraft adds six new diseases to Minecraft, which can happen randomly or from disease-causing events such as standing in fire or getting hit by a cave spider.

<details>
<summary>Arachnia</summary>
   Causes:

   Getting hit by a cave spider
   
   Eating a spider eye

  
  Symptoms:
  
  Nausea at onset
  
  Slowness
  
  Dark particles
  
  Poison

  
  Cures:
  
  Arachnitum
</details>

<details>
<summary>Common Cold</summary>
Causes:
  Occurs randomly. Higher chance in colder biomes.

  
  Symptoms:
  
  Slowness
  
  Sneezes

  
  Cures:
  
  Waiting
  
  Minelenol
</details>

<details>
<summary>Rottenness</summary>
Causes:
  
  Getting hit by a husk
  
  Eating rotten flesh

  
  Symptoms:
  
  Nausea at onset
  
  Periodic Hunger
  
  Health Reduction

  
  Cures:
  
  Pure Leaf
</details>

<details>
<summary>Blazing</summary>
Causes:
  
  Being set on fire without fire resistance

  
  Symptoms:
  
  Blindness at onset
  
  Flame particles
  
  Longer burning time
  
  Random fires appearing
  
  
  Cures:
  
  Fire Resistance Potion
  
</details>

<details>
<summary>Teneguor</summary>
Causes:
  
  Darkness effect
  
  
  Symptoms:
  
  Slowness at onset
  
  Dark particles
  
  Periodic Darkness effect
  
  Warden spawns
  
  
  Cures:
  
  Standing in fire
</details>

<details>
<summary>Salmonella</summary>
Causes:
  
Eating raw meat


Symptoms:

Hunger at onset

Nausea


Cures:

Waiting

Drinking water can stop nausea and help the disease end more quickly
</details>

To combat these diseases, the datapack also adds some treatments:


<details>
<summary>Cough Drop</summary>

![Cough Drop Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/PIHNaEE.png)
  
Crafted with one honeycomb and one sugar as in the layout above.


Effects:

Stops sneezes for 20 minutes
</details>

<details>
<summary>Minelenol</summary>
  
![Minelenol Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/WAtaU8Y.png)
  
Crafted with two coal, two charcoal, and one flint as in the layout above.


Effects:

Cures Common Cold

Stops players from getting the common cold for 10 minutes

Stops all diseases from getting worse for 10 minutes

If two are taken in a span of 20 minutes, overdose will occur, resulting in slowness, nausea, and weakness
</details>

<details>
<summary>Arachnitum</summary>
  
![Arachnitum Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/GASqEDh.png)
  
Crafted with two fermented spider eyes and two wheat as in the layout above.


Effects:

Cures Arachnia

1 minute of Slowness I

1 minute of Weakness II
</details>

<details>
<summary>Pure Leaf</summary>
  
![Pure Leaf Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/X24vHcK.png)
  
Crafted with three leaves (of any type) and two short grass as in the layout above.


Effects:

Cures Rottenness

2 minutes of Weakness II
</details>

<details>
<summary>Disease Test</summary>
  
![Disease Test Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/2FYqIxS.png)
  
Crafted using four iron ingots and one redstone block as in the layout above.

Effects:

Displays the diseases that the player currently has

Causes some damage
</details>

Use `/trigger RevealInfections` to toggle whether or not players are alerted when diseases come and go away.
Use `/trigger CureUponDeath` to toggle whether or not players are cured after death.
